ja: ＨＧＣＣ 1/144 ターンエーガンダムを華やかに演出！拡張エフェクトユニット“月光蝶”登場！
※ 当商品は「ＨＧＣＣ １／１４４ ターンエーガンダム」（別売）専用の拡張エフェクトユニットです。
当商品に「ＨＧＣＣ １／１４４ ターンエーガンダム」は付属しません。
『∀ガンダム』劇中シーンで有名な最強兵器“月光蝶”を再現するエフェクト、本体ジョイントパーツ、専用スタンドがセットになり、
拡張ユニットとして登場!!
「ＨＧＣＣ ターンエーガンダム」（２０１４年４月店頭発売予定 ※別売）にエフェクトパーツ“月光蝶”を装着し、
劇中の印象深いシーンを再現可能。
●●エフェクト“月光蝶”
なめらかなカーブを描く外観形状で、蝶の羽のような多彩な色彩の紋様をプリント。
表面にはホログラム加工を施行し、虹色のような複雑な光を表現。
● 本体ジョイントパーツ
エフェクトの開閉角度が調整可能。また、エフェクトの美しい柄に干渉しないクリア成形を採用。
● 専用スタンド
劇中の“月光蝶”シーンのディスプレイに欠かせない特別カラーの専用スタンドが付属。
パーツの差し替えで、角度や支柱の長さ調節が可能。
華やかなイメージのミルキーホワイト（乳白色）の成形色。
（セット内容）
・　ＨＧＣＣ ターンエーガンダム用エフェクト“月光蝶”（左右各１）
・　本体ジョイントパーツ
・　専用スタンド（ミルキーホワイト）

en: HGCC 1/144 A gorgeous production of Turn A Gundam! Introducing the extended effect unit “Hikaricho”!
* This product is an expansion effect unit exclusively for "HGCC 1/144 Turn-A Gundam" (sold separately).
"HGCC 1/144 Turn A Gundam" is not included with this product.
-------------- The most powerful weapon that will destroy everything "Light Butterfly" --------------
A set that includes effects, body joint parts, and a special stand that recreates the most powerful weapon "Light Butterfly" that is famous for the scene in the "∀Gundam" movie.
Introduced as an expansion unit!!
"HGCC Turn A Gundam" (20144 Store Release Scheduled *sold separately) is equipped with the effect part "Light Butterfly",
It is possible to reproduce impressive scenes from the play.
●●Effect “Light Butterfly”
The exterior has a smooth curve and is printed with a pattern of various colors that resembles the wings of a butterfly.
The surface is holographically processed to create a complex rainbow-like light.
● Body joint parts
The opening and closing angle of the effect can be adjusted. In addition, clear molding is used that does not interfere with the beautiful pattern of the effect.
● Dedicated stand
A special stand in a special color is included, which is essential for displaying the "light butterfly" scene in the play.
The angle and length of the support can be adjusted by replacing parts.
Milky white molding color with a gorgeous image.
(Set contents)
・ HGCC Turn A Gundam effect “Light Butterfly” (1 each on the left and right)
・Body joint parts
・Special stand (milky white)
*"HGCC 1/144 Turn A Gundam" is not included with this product.
This product is a combination of the "HGCC 1/144 Turn A Gundam" (sold separately) and the "Light Butterfly" effect.
An expansion effects unit for reproducing and enjoying scenes from the movie.
* To reproduce the published photo, this product and "HGCC 1/144 Turn-A Gundam" (sold separately) are required.
Also, "HGCC 1/144 Turn A Gundam" (sold separately) is not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
**The photos shown were taken in a dark environment with a black background and a light source close to the camera.
It is not designed to always reflect complex light at all angles. Thank you for your understanding.
Molded part: Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: (effect) PET (molded product) PS/ABS
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
[This product does not include HGCC 1/144 Turn-A Gundam]
*The finished product in the photo has been partially painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
